body:
Willis Lease Finance Corporation (WLFC) has completed the acquisition of two Airbus A320 aircraft, further diversifying its aviation asset portfolio beyond its core engine leasing business.

The acquisitions reflect the company’s strategy to expand its asset base and meet growing customer demand for aircraft and flexible leasing solutions.

“Demand for assets and flexible leasing solutions remains exceptionally strong in today’s environment,” said Austin C. Willis, President and Chief Executive Officer of Willis Lease Finance.

“We continue to grow our portfolio and strengthen our ability to serve airline customers around the world. The addition of both a new-generation A320neo and an A320ceo reflects our disciplined approach to investing in diverse assets,” he added.
